intro: Over ten articles published between April 16 and August 28, 2026, ZCyberNews covered distributed denial-of-service activity, with six reports rated high severity, three medium, and one informational. Threat actors Dort, Mirai, and Moobot were observed across incidents affecting internet infrastructure, telecommunications, cybersecurity services, hosting, and social media. The coverage referenced CVE-2025-29635 (CVSS 8.8) and CVE-2024-3721 (CVSS 6.3). Reported impacts spanned Brazil, Canada, Germany, the United States, and global networks, reflecting a broad geographic footprint in the analyzed reporting period.
